request.text: For tomorrow's lunchtime walk, check whether it will rain in Hangzhou, set a 12:20 p.m. reminder to take my inhaler, and give me a short, gentle warm-up I can do before leaving.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up whether rain is expected in Hangzhou around lunchtime tomorrow for the user's planned walk.
Create a reminder for 12:20 p.m. tomorrow to take the user's inhaler.
Provide a short, gentle spoken warm-up the user can do before leaving for the walk.

new_goals.description: Obtain Hangzhou's rain outlook for tomorrow at lunchtime to inform the planned walk.
new_goals.source_text: For tomorrow's lunchtime walk, check whether it will rain in Hangzhou.
constraints: Use Hangzhou as the location, tomorrow as the date, and lunchtime as the period.
Do not decide whether the user should walk.
success_criteria: Weather information addresses the specified place, date, period, and rain question.

new_goals.description: Create a 12:20 p.m. tomorrow reminder for the user's inhaler.
new_goals.source_text: Set a 12:20 p.m. reminder to take my inhaler.
constraints: Schedule the reminder for tomorrow at 12:20 p.m.
Keep the reminder wording about taking the user's inhaler.
success_criteria: One reminder is created with the requested time and purpose.

new_goals.description: Give the user a short, gentle spoken warm-up for before the walk.
new_goals.source_text: Give me a short, gentle warm-up I can do before leaving.
constraints: Keep the routine short and gentle.
Offer guidance rather than claiming to move the user's body.
success_criteria: The user receives an easy-to-follow warm-up suitable for doing before departure.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The turn establishes three distinct new Goals: a weather lookup, a reminder effect, and spoken warm-up guidance.

semantic_facts: The plan must preserve all three Goals: query Hangzhou for rain tomorrow at lunchtime, create the inhaler reminder for 12:20 p.m. tomorrow, and provide a short gentle warm-up.
The weather lookup and reminder are independent executable work and need not be serialized with each other; the warm-up remains assistant-owned spoken guidance.
The weather result may inform the user but must not silently replace the separate reminder or warm-up Goals.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims the forecast was obtained, the reminder was created, or the warm-up was performed before trusted execution.
The planner diagnoses the user's breathing condition, changes inhaler instructions, or decides whether the user should walk.
A body-action Capability is used to simulate or perform the user's warm-up.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Multiple independent Goals are collapsed into one generic walk-preparation response.
Executable weather and reminder work is replaced by unsupported prose, or spoken guidance is incorrectly assigned to a body Capability.
